subject: german
title: Technologische Innovation
welcome_lead: Germany is famed for engineering. Discuss AI, robotics, and the future of work in German.
final_note: Innovation needs the vocabulary to be debated.

walkthroughs.body_html: KI verandert die Arbeitswelt. Balance: einerseits Chancen, andererseits Risiken.
Die digitale Kluft separates connected from disconnected. Der Zugang zum Internet muss universal sein.
Use Futur I: Die Technologie wird unser Leben verandern. For hypotheses: Konjunktiv II.
